question: Who was the only female Muslim ruler to ever rule India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Razia Sultan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Razia Sultan** ruled **Delhi Sultanate** from **1236 to 1240 AD.**
 
• Razia Sultan was the **daughter of Sultan Iltutmish **and was trained in **military and administrative skills **from a young age.
 
• She was a progressive ruler who **abolished the Jaziya tax** on non-Muslims and** appointed Hindus **in high positions in the court.
 
• However, her reign was **short-lived **as she faced opposition from the nobles who did not want to be **ruled by a woman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rabia-ud-durani, is** not** a known historical figure.
 
• Haazi Begum, was the **wife of Mughal Emperor Humayun** and did not rule independently.
 
• Arzumand Bano, was the real name of **Mumtaz Mahal,** the wife of Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan, who is famous for building the** Taj Mahal in her memory.**
